A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] '''Thermal Detonator Trooper''', alternatively known as a '''grenade trooper''', was a type of [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] trained to shoot [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. They were primarily used to damage buildings and posed a risk to their own allies if they tried to attack individuals.
